title: INT8 calibration sandbox + immutable audit trace for bespoke customer profiling
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Customer request: Run a bespoke INT8 calibration sweep for a financial risk scoring model that has shown accuracy drift after our standard FP8->INT8 prescriptive profile. They require an isolated sandbox run (on their Dedicated pool) with an immutable audit trace showing sample selection, per-layer scaling factors, calibration seeds, and evaluation results. Goals: 1) produce a validated INT8 profile that meets the customer's accuracy SLA (no more than 1.5% end-to-end AUC drop versus FP32 baseline on their validation set), 2) provide a reproducible artifact and audit log suitable for their compliance review, and 3) codify rollback and fallback to FP8/FP32 variants automatically if post-deploy telemetry shows regression. Scope: design ephemeral calibration environment, stratified sample selection strategy, measurement metrics (AUC, per-class recall, token-level edit rate for text outputs), exportable artifacts (calib profile JSON, per-layer histograms, evaluation reports), and an immutable audit bundle (signed metadata + S3 object + manifest). Out of scope: model retraining or business logic changes to model architecture. Acceptance criteria: bespoke INT8 profile is validated on customer test harness with metrics above thresholds, artifacts uploaded to the customer S3 bucket, audit manifest generated and signed, deployment runbook and rollback playbook reviewed by PM and Security. Notes on approach: prefer deterministic calibration seeds, deterministic integer rounding policy documented, and a stratified probe that over-samples edge-case tokens identified by customer. Also include a cost estimate (GPU-hours) and run-time estimate for scheduling. This ticket coordinates engineering work, customer support liaison, and security compliance for audit artifacts.
comments: 2025-11-03 - Aisha Patel: Initial triage call with customer. They provided a 200k-sample validation set and require auditability for compliance. Customer expects results within two weeks.

2025-11-04 - Miguel Santos: Proposed plan for ephemeral calibration sandbox on customer's Dedicated pool. Will use stratified sampling (by class/length/rare-token buckets) and run per-layer symmetric min-max and KL-based clipping experiments. Asking infra for RTX A5000 availability on 2025-11-10.

2025-11-05 - PM (Jules Park): Confirmed acceptance criteria and compliance requirements. Security requested signed manifest and retention policy for audit bundle. Added security review to dependencies.

2025-11-07 - Miguel Santos: Implemented calibration job orchestration. Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1439. Need infra changes to allow customer-scoped ephemeral S3 write role. Filed infra ticket ENG-58220.

2025-11-09 - QA (Lara Nguyen): Ran smoke probe using a 10k stratified subset. Observed an unexpected per-layer scale collapse on transformer block 9 for longest-sequence bucket. Investigating whether this is sampling bias or implementation bug.

2025-11-10 - Miguel Santos: Root cause: tensor quantization clamp applied before layer norm in the calibration path for sequences > 1024. Patch submitted and tests added. PR updated to https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1439 (files changed).
notes: Trade-offs discussed: running full-grid calibration (expensive but comprehensive) versus adaptive probe (faster, may miss rare failure modes). Customer opted for two-stage: adaptive probe first, and full-grid only if adaptive probe shows >0.75% delta in any critical metric.

Rollback strategy: publish calibrated INT8 profile to model catalog with a canary rollout using 5% traffic and automatic fallback to FP8 if telemetry exceeds error thresholds for 10 consecutive minutes.
Operational follow-ups: add automated telemetry check in Console to surface token-level regressions and integrate with incident runbook for immediate mitigation.
